mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS numbers,dates AS dates FROM system_burying_point_record where environment=#{vo.environment} and field_page=#{vo.field_page} and dates BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(#{vo.dates}, INTERVAL 30 DAY ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) and DATE_FORMAT(#{vo.dates},'%Y-%m-%d') -- and department!='日报制支持' and department!='测试部门' GROUP BY dates ORDER BY dates

SELECT
sum(numbers) AS numbers, indicator_page AS indicators FROM system_burying_point_record WHERE dim = #{vo.dim} AND dates = #{vo.dates} AND environment = #{vo.environment} -- AND department != '日报制支持' -- AND department != '测试部门' GROUP BY indicator_page ORDER BY numbers DESC
sum(numbers) AS numbers FROM system_burying_point_record WHERE dim !=0 AND dates = #{vo.dates} AND environment = #{vo.environment} -- AND department != '日报制支持' -- AND department != '测试部门' UNION ALL SELECT sum(numbers) AS numbers FROM system_burying_point_record WHERE dim ='1' AND dates = #{vo.dates} AND environment = #{vo.environment} -- AND department != '日报制支持' -- AND department != '测试部门' UNION ALL SELECT sum(numbers) AS numbers FROM system_burying_point_record WHERE dim ='2' AND dates = #{vo.dates} AND environment = #{vo.environment} -- AND department != '日报制支持' -- AND department != '测试部门'
